_comment: #1971 — /api/coaching-dashboard under a tier >= 2 budget pause (regeneration_paused: true). Shape mirrors the inline handler in lambdas/web/site_api_lambda.py; values are realistic-but-static and in-range for the accuracy rubric. The paused flag is the point: the gate asserts the roster cards render the 'refresh paused (budget guard)' kicker (.rd-paused). #3252 re-anchored the timestamps onto the live cycle-14 window (genesis 2026-08-17) and added the fields the served payload now carries — _meta.generated_at is the OLDEST member's stamp (not the request instant), _meta.served_at is the request instant, weekly_priority.as_of_day_n anchors the integrator's relative-time prose, and content_day_span discloses that the board's members were written on different days. The stamps here are the shape the writers actually emit (microseconds + '+00:00'), and the day numbers are consistent with the genesis above — a fixture whose day numbers contradicted its own timestamps would teach the render gate the wrong thing.
